proof_summary: Split into the cases \(n\le 122\) and \(n>122\): for the finite initial range, explicit prime witnesses are exhibited between each pair of consecutive squares. For \(n>122\), positivity of the count yields a twin-prime pair whose smaller member \(p\) satisfies \(n^2<p\) and \(p+2<(n+1)^2\), so \(p\) itself is the required prime.
